means: The danbooru count tag for 'more than one male, number unspecified'. Counting grammar, like 1boy - it sets the population of the frame.
does: Puts two or more males in frame but leaves the number to the model, which usually settles on three or more and degrades as it climbs. Critically, it REVOKES solo: leaving solo in the prompt beside it is a flat contradiction and the model resolves it by merging bodies - shared limbs, two heads on one torso, faces that land as neither character. Prefer an exact count whenever you have one; 2boys is a sharper instruction than this.
reach_for_it: background groupings where the exact head count genuinely does not matter - and almost never for a staged two-hander
used_in: zero uses across the nine authored films - the library avoids it. studio/roadmap/blocking.md warns at 3 or more characters, calling it where the model reliably falls apart
example_base: 1boy, solo, male focus, short black hair, dark jacket, standing on a rooftop, city skyline behind, late afternoon sun, looking away, masterpiece, best quality, very aesthetic, absurdres
read_it_as: Compare the SHADING, colour and line - not the pose or framing. Adding any clause re-rolls the model's conditioning, so composition moves between the two panels even at a fixed seed. An img2img pass from one fixed base image would isolate the tag properly; that is not built yet.
